stock.description: Shunfeng International Clean Energy Limited (SFCE), through its various subsidiaries, offers integrated clean energy and low-carbon, energy-saving solutions within the People's Republic of China and to a global clientele. The company's activities include the production and sale of solar products, as well as providing installation services for these systems. SFCE is also active in solar power generation and is engaged in the development of hydrogen energy equipment specifically designed for heavy-duty trucks. Headquartered in Central, Hong Kong, the firm adopted its current name in November 2014, having previously been known as Shunfeng Photovoltaic International Limited.
